constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
A black sports car is on an empty showroom floor.
The black sports car has a carbon fibre body.

Creative addition: the showroom floor is polished, with overhead light creating reflections beneath the car; a restrained engine rumble, soft tyre roll, and a quiet ambient drone support the movement.

description.text: The complete supplied image is preserved at the opening instant, holding the full showroom composition exactly as supplied: the black sports car rests on an empty showroom floor, with darkness gathered around the vehicle and the polished floor extending toward the foreground. As the shot begins, the car pulls forward out of that darkness, its carbon fibre body emerging into the light so that the woven surface catches and releases soft highlights along the hood, flanks, and roofline. The movement is steady and deliberate, with the car advancing toward the viewer while the surrounding space remains spare and uncluttered. Light from above and ahead plays across the floor, laying a long, shifting reflection beneath the car and separating the deep blacks of the bodywork from the cooler grey tones of the showroom. The tyres roll with a low, continuous texture over the smooth surface, and the engine note stays restrained, a deep rumble rather than a sharp rev. As the car grows larger in the frame, the contrast between the illuminated body and the receding darkness sharpens; edges of the carbon-fibre panels pick up narrow gleams, while the shadowed sections retain their density. The empty floor and distant walls keep the focus on the car's slow advance, and the broad floorplane gives the movement a clear sense of distance and scale. By the end of the shot, the vehicle has moved fully into the lit space, its shape clearer and its reflection stretched across the polished floor, while the showroom remains otherwise still. The sequence stays continuous, preserving the complete first-frame image at the anchor and then allowing the action to develop naturally from that exact composition.
The full supplied frame is held: the black sports car sits on the empty showroom floor, surrounded by darkness, with the polished floor stretching into the foreground.
The car pulls forward out of the dark, beginning its steady advance toward the viewer.
A low engine rumble starts and remains restrained.
Tyres roll softly across the polished showroom floor.
The car grows larger in frame as it moves fully into the light, carbon-fibre panels picking up highlights.
A long reflection of the car stretches across the polished floor while the surrounding showroom stays empty and still.
The engine note settles into a deep, even tone beneath the continuing tyre roll.

soundscape: Low engine rumble and soft tyre roll across a polished showroom floor, under a faint room tone.
music: A quiet, sustained ambient drone with a low pulse, kept well beneath the engine and tyre sounds.
